_meta.purpose: Source registry for the Miqyas ITU AI for Good Hackathon (UAE) knowledge base. Every KB chunk traces back to one entry here.
rules: Public documents only. No member data, no personal health data.

redistribute: 'excerpt' = the public export ships only the first 60 words of each chunk plus citation; 'full' = whole chunk text may be published; 'link-only' = nothing from the document is published.
fetch.method: 'http' = scripts/fetch_sources.py can re-download it; 'browser' = captured from a bot-protected official page by hand; 'manual-pending' = NOT yet in the KB, a person must download it.

review_status is always 'not-legally-reviewed': nothing here has been checked by a UAE lawyer. clinical_content=true marks material with clinical practice content, which is 'clinical-unreviewed' (no clinician sign-off).

nodes = ITU-T Y.3172 pipeline nodes (SRC, C, PP, M, P, D, SINK, MLFO, SANDBOX); dimensions = AI Readiness Framework 2.0 dimensions D1-D13. Both are the analyst's own mapping, for the report template table, and are unreviewed.
